# Reference test data

`ouroboros-consensus/` holds the Shelley to Conway `Header_*` golden files
copied unchanged from
[IntersectMBO/ouroboros-consensus](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/ouroboros-consensus)
at revision `ec239d57f618d698b6350b48bf017b02c0c96a5f`, path
`ouroboros-consensus-cardano/golden/cardano/CardanoNodeToNodeVersion2/`.
`ouroboros-consensus.sha256` lists each file's SHA-256 as computed from that
revision's checkout. `header_reference_test.go` uses them.
